name: ACID (Adversarial Calibration Iterative Deep learning)
definition: ACID is a reconstruction method that searches for a solution good in three aspects: image sparsity, big-data-driven prior, and iterative calibration to eliminate unexplained residual data.
summary: ACID is an iterative reconstruction framework that stabilizes deep learning by combining it with compressed sensing sparsity and iterative residual calibration to eliminate unexplained data errors.
